<observations>
Date: Jul 6 - 15, 2026
* 🔴 User stated wedding parameters: hashtag #ToHaveAndToHolt2026, max reception guests 150 (catering cutoff Sept 1, 2026), floral budget max $4,500, venue walkthrough Aug 26, 2026, and videographer final payment due Aug 10, 2026.
* 🔴 User updated cake flavor to pistachio (superseding lemon raspberry).
* 🟡 Agent configured wedding portal (RSVP automation, hashtag banner, dietary icons) and managed vendor outreach for catering allergen protocols (cousin Thomas has peanut allergies), minimalist gold geometric decor, white rose/eucalyptus florals, and photography timelines.

Date: Jul 19 - 23, 2026
* 🔴 User stated final rehearsal dinner is at The Rustic Hearth Restaurant for strictly 35 guests.
* 🔴 User specified welcome bags with local craft beer/artisan chocolate and personalized ceramic coaster wedding favors.
* 🟡 Agent compiled acoustic indie playlists, updated seating charts (college friends at table four), coordinated pure mulberry silk morning robes, pre-ceremony candid coffee photography, midnight return shuttle service, and vintage 1965 convertible getaway car.
* ✅ Agent confirmed gluten-free macaron tower addition with Sweet Treats Bakery.
</observations>
